pages.text:
Flowers hold the seven primal elements: **Terra** (earth), **Aqua** (water), **Ignis** (fire), **Aer** (air), **Vita** (life), **Lux** (light) and **Umbra** (shadow).

Ground with a [[mortar_and_pestle]], flowers become [[elemental_powders|elemental powders]]. A powder used on a living flower makes it an [[elemental_flora|elemental flora]], a reservoir of its element's **essence**.

The [[apothecary_altar]] burns plants into essence for the flora around it, and the [[apothecary_crucible]] draws it back out to inscribe [[mob_filters|mob filters]].

Metallurgic craft is the earthier side: tin and bronze, worked into armor, tools and machines. See [[metallurgic_overview]].
